result.content: {"reasoning":"From the headline ('Atlas-L scores highest on overall quality and Brisk-S costs least; each step up costs sharply more per point, so the owner must price a point, at this run's unknown provider routing'), decision block ('Our lean... Atlas-M as the middle step', 'Where the answer flips...'), and first claim alone ('Price per point of quality rises steeply up the frontier...'), a reader immediately knows what is unresolved/what to do (owner must price a point; Atlas-M is the lean), why (steep cost increases per point from $4.94 to $15), and the primary risk/caveat (unknown provider routing repricing the frontier and unnamed judge). The reader is exceptionally well served on the first screen.","criteria_scores":{"report_writer.first_screen":"5"}}
